name: codex-image-grid
description: Native macOS image-generation plugin for Codex. It supports Prompt Batch, reference images, thumbnails, and project, article, or video visuals through codex_image_grid/generate_image_grid.

interface.shortDescription: Native Prompt Batch image generation for Codex workflows
interface.longDescription: The public Codex Image Grid route for English or Japanese image-generation requests, Prompt Batch work, thumbnails, and project, article, or video visuals. It exposes codex_image_grid/generate_image_grid through MCP, automatically opens the native SwiftUI app, accepts local reference-image paths, and returns the job status, manifest, handoff, image paths, and Codex Markdown contract used by CodexVideo and RelayPress. The separate retired Electron project is not a runtime fallback.
defaultPrompt: Generate the requested images with Codex Image Grid
Create a Prompt Batch of thumbnails for this project
Create article or video visuals with Codex Image Grid
